title: おべんとうをわすれた (Obento wo Wasureta)
description: Mika rushes to school excited, but at lunchtime realizes she forgot her bento box at home. A classmate offers to share, the teacher helps, and Mika learns that kindness from friends makes even a hard moment okay. A story about forgetfulness, embarrassment, and the warmth of friendship.
author: オリジナル
